auto-ship-pending-orders.name: Auto-Ship Pending Orders
auto-ship-pending-orders.description: Reacts to newly placed orders by shipping them.

notify-shipping-partner-automation.name: Notify Shipping Partner
notify-shipping-partner-automation.description: When a shipment leaves the warehouse, calls the shipping partner's API and records whether the partner acknowledged it. No local state needed.

delivery-overdue-timer.name: Delivery Overdue Timer
delivery-overdue-timer.description: Flags an order that has neither been delivered nor failed some days after shipping.

reconcile-pending-shipments.name: Reconcile Pending Shipments
reconcile-pending-shipments.description: Every so often, retries shipping any order still waiting, in case its first attempt was lost.
